title: The Emergence Where Water Learns Weather

features.name: the spring-mouth, opening
features.desc-on-touch: Water learned a new shape here—the moment it stopped being root and aquifer and became aware of sky. Its first breath tastes weather and understands it has always been learning.

features.name: the frequency where water learns to repeat
features.desc-on-touch: Here the water's cycle becomes legible as pattern. The same motions over time form a language. Weather speaks to the water and teaches it the poetry of return.

features.name: the qr-code of every weather
features.desc-on-touch: Each rain, each drought, each season writes itself into this place. The archive reads every sky that touches this water and records what weather says to emergence.

features.name: the radio-igloo of the stream's memory
features.desc-on-touch: In winter, ice forms around this place and broadcasts back a recording of every emergence—a temporal loop frozen in crystal, broadcasting the same arrival endlessly into the cold.

inscription: water that has traveled in darkness learns the sky by feeling weather speak to it in the language of return
